titre: King in check. Should he hide in the corner? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Bishop's Opening. In check from the knight, Black ran to the corner with 8...Kg8?? and it's mate in 3: 9.Qb3+ d5 (only move) 10.exd6+ en passant, a discovered check (only Be6 blocks) 11.Qxe6#. The right square was 8...Ke8. Seen in 2 real Lichess games (puzzle rating ~1874). Checked with Stockfish. Would you have hidden in the corner? 👇

Analyze your own game, free: https://blundercheck.app/try?src=youtube-en
